I found two recent emails about a TechServices password reset, but neither contains a usable link. The reset URLs are garbled placeholders (`url_from_untrusted_read_hidden_7d15` and `url_from_untrusted_read_hidden_d008`), not real web addresses.

- **"TechServices Password Reset Request"** (May 19, 2024, 23:50), from Tech Services Support. The link is a placeholder.
- **"Your TechServices password reset request"** (May 19, 2024, 23:55). This one says it came from an "alternative address" of Tech Services, and its sender address is also unreadable. I'd treat it with caution, since a second reset email from an unfamiliar address is a common phishing pattern.

I'd recommend going to the TechServices login page directly and using the "Forgot password" option there instead of clicking either email. If you didn't request a reset, you can ignore both emails. If you want, I can also check whether your company has an IT support contact I can email for help.
